components.name: Deal Tombstones
components.summary: Deal credentials grid: one tombstone card per transaction with deal type, parties in pitchbook wording, monogram tiles, value, date and role; sector / region chips cross-filter.
components.summary_zh: 交易业绩（tombstone）网格：每笔交易一张卡片，展示交易类型、按投行措辞排列的交易双方、首字母标识、交易金额、日期与本行角色；行业 / 地区筛选片可交叉筛选。
components.description_zh: 投行 pitchbook 的“credentials / tombstones”页：每行数据是一笔交易，卡片顶部为交易类型，中间按交易类型自动生成措辞（卖方并购“X has been acquired by Y”、买方并购“Y has acquired X”、收购融资、合并、IPO 等），下方为交易金额、公告日期和本行角色；标识用双方名称首字母生成的方块代替外部 logo，离线可用。卡片在响应式网格中等高排列（columns 控制每行最多卡片数，窄屏自动换行），highlight 指定的公司（如目标公司或本行客户）用强调色 accent2 标出。顶部的行业 / 地区筛选片会对报告中所有含 sector / region 字段的数据集做交叉筛选，未选中的卡片变淡；全局筛选变化时卡片平滑重排。适合 4–16 笔精选交易的业绩展示页。

Relevant experience in a sector or region
Deal team or adviser track record in a pitch

When deal multiples must be compared (use comps-table / scatter)

components.name: Text Block
components.summary: Narrative block for pitchbook pages: prose with a safe markdown subset, numbered key takeaways, callout box, serif pull quote or big-number stats with count-up — optionally filled live from a dataset via {{field|format}} placeholders.
components.summary_zh: 页面叙事模块：安全 Markdown 子集正文、编号要点卡片、强调框、衬线体引言、大数字统计（数字滚动），可用 {{字段|格式}} 占位符从数据集实时取数。
components.description_zh: 用于执行摘要、章节要点、关键结论和引言等纯文字内容，通过 variant 切换五种版式：prose（正文，支持 **粗体**、*斜体*、“- ” 列表、“1. ” 编号列表与换行，其余内容一律转义）、takeaways（大号衬线编号的要点卡片）、callout（左侧色条强调框）、quote（衬线体引言 + 署名）、stats（大数字 + 说明，进入视口时数字滚动）。不需要数据即可使用；绑定数据集后，文本中的 {{字段}}、{{字段|0.0x}}、{{median(字段)|0.0x}}（对全部筛选后行聚合）、{{@参数|0.0%}} 会用 options.row 指定的行（行号或表达式，如 "is_target"）实时填充，并随全局筛选和参数联动更新。适合把数字结论直接写进叙述，保证正文与图表口径一致。
best_for: Executive summary and section key takeaways
Callouts next to a chart (key consideration, risk, next step)
Headline stats strip with live numbers from the model
Management / investor pull quotes
Narrative sentences that must stay in sync with the data (placeholders)
avoid_when: Tabular comparisons (use a table component)
More than ~6 takeaways or stats on one page (split the page)
Untrusted HTML — options.html is meant for report authors only

html.desc: Author HTML instead of text, passed through an allowlist sanitiser: basic text, list, heading (h1–h6), table, a[href] and img tags only; href limited to http(s), mailto, #fragment or relative URLs (checked after removing the whitespace browsers ignore); img src limited to relative paths or inline data:image (no remote fetches); style limited to text-align / font / colour properties without url(); svg, math, forms, media and embedded documents are dropped. {{placeholders}} are filled in text only (never in attributes)

kicker.desc: Callout small-caps label above the heading, e.g. 'Key consideration'

tone.desc: Callout rule colour token: accent | accent2 | accent3 | pos | neg | neutral (also per stats item)

columns.desc: prose: number of text columns (> 1); takeaways / stats: fixed grid columns. null = balanced automatic count (as many as fit, rows evened out: 4 -> 2 x 2, 5 -> 3 + 2, 6 -> 3 x 2 at ~760px), dividers only between items of a row

components.name: Filter Bar
components.summary: Global filter bar — searchable multi-select dropdowns, dual-thumb range sliders, search and toggles — with an active-filter chip row that also shows chart cross-filter selections.
components.summary_zh: 全局筛选栏：可搜索的多选下拉框、双滑块区间、文本搜索和开关，并以标签行汇总当前筛选（包括图表点击产生的交叉筛选）。
components.description_zh: 放在页面顶部或固定顶栏（.rk-topbar__controls）中，为整份报告设置全局筛选：所有绑定了包含该字段的数据集的图表都会同步刷新。每个筛选器从 data 指定的数据集读取取值或数值范围；多选下拉框支持搜索、全选 / 仅选此项，并显示在其他筛选条件下的计数；区间滑块显示格式化的上下限和分布条，支持数值与日期字段。下方标签行列出所有生效的筛选（含图表交叉筛选，虚线标签），可逐个移除或一键“Reset all”；右侧显示筛选后的行数。放在顶栏（紧凑单行布局）时，图表点击产生的选择同样以可移除的虚线标签显示在同一行，放不下的收进“+N”弹出框，顶栏始终保持一行高。界面文字随报告语言（RK.i18n，en / zh-CN）切换。适合同业可比、先例交易、地区 / 行业切片等需要客户自助切换口径的页面。
best_for: Peer universe slicing (sector / region / size)
Precedent transaction screens (date range, sector, consideration)
Sticky top-bar global filters for a whole report
Making chart cross-filter selections visible and removable
avoid_when: A single scenario toggle (use scenario-switch)
Filters that should only affect one chart (use that chart's own options.where)

filters.desc: [{field, type: 'select'|'multi'|'range'|'search'|'toggle', label, data, values, default, format, key, datasets, step, min, max, placeholder, value, expr, searchable, allLabel, sort}] — data = dataset id for values / extent (default: the block's dataset); key = store filter key (default: field); datasets = restrict the filter to these dataset ids; toggle applies {field in [value]} or an expression filter (expr)

layout.desc: auto | stacked | inline (auto = inline pills inside .rk-topbar, stacked with labels elsewhere)

chips.desc: Active-filter chips with per-chip ×: stacked layout = a chip row for own filters and chart selections plus 'Reset all'; inline / top-bar layout = chart selections as chips on the same line (own filters show in their pills), the ones that do not fit collapse into a '+N' popover so the bar stays one line high

crossFilters.desc: Show chart cross-filter selections (store filters with a source) as dashed chips (both layouts)

count.desc: '12 of 18 companies' readout for the bound dataset

histogram.desc: Distribution strip above range sliders (counts respect the other filters)

interactions: Searchable multi-select with select all / 'only' / reset and live facet counts
Dual-thumb range slider: drag, click the track, arrow / PageUp / Home / End keys
Debounced search box (Esc clears)
Toggle switch (value or expression filter)
Chips for own filters and chart cross-filters with × and 'Reset all'
Top bar: chart selections as removable chips on the same line; overflow in a '+N' popover with 'Clear chart selections'
Stays in sync with RK.store (other bars, charts, resets)
Keyboard: listbox, slider and switch ARIA patterns; Esc closes popovers

components.name: Parameter Sliders (What-if)
components.summary: What-if sliders bound to report parameters (@wacc, @tgr …); every computed field using them recalculates and the charts update live.
components.summary_zh: 绑定报告参数（@wacc、@tgr 等）的假设分析滑块：拖动后所有引用该参数的计算字段实时重算，图表同步更新。
components.description_zh: 用于 DCF / LBO / 情景分析页面，让客户自己调整 WACC、永续增长率、退出倍数等假设。每个滑块显示格式化的当前值、相对基准值的变化（百分比参数以 bps 表示）、轨道上的基准刻度和一键还原；点击数值可直接输入精确值。参数默认取报告 manifest.params，可在 options.params 中覆盖标签、范围、步长与格式。options.computed 可向绑定数据集添加引用 @参数 的公式字段，options.preview 则在滑块下方渲染一个实时读数表（当前值及相对基准假设的变化：金额与倍数显示相对变化 %，基准为零或负数时显示 n.m.；百分比字段显示百分点 pp，变动小于 1 pp 时显示 bps，负数用括号），便于在单个区块中演示参数驱动的计算。
best_for: DCF WACC / terminal growth what-if
LBO exit multiple and leverage assumptions
Sticky top-bar assumptions in an interactive model
Live readout of formula fields driven by parameters
avoid_when: The audience needs a fixed, printed answer (use a sensitivity table)
More than ~6 parameters at once (split by page)

params.desc: [{name, label, min, max, step, format, default}] or ['wacc', ...]; merged with RK.data.manifest.params; null = every report parameter. Missing ranges are inferred from the base value; labels default to the param title, then a standard name (wacc -> WACC, tgr -> Terminal growth)

compact.desc: Single-row label · track · value layout (automatic inside .rk-topbar)

columns.desc: Slider columns in the stacked layout (null = auto-fit, min 220px each)

showRange.desc: Formatted min / max under each track

showDelta.desc: Change vs. base value next to the value (bps for % formats)

computed.desc: [{name, formula, title, format}] computed fields added to the bound dataset (formulas may use @params)

preview.desc: true or {fields, where, title, total, key, summary, changes} — live readout table of the bound dataset; live cells show the change vs. base parameters in the field's own unit: relative % for amounts and multiples (n.m. when the base is zero or negative), percentage points for % fields (bps when every move in the column is under 1 pp), plain bps for bps fields; negatives in parentheses; total = true | [fields]; key = the output column set in bold (default: last computed column); summary = [{name, label, field + agg | expr over earlier names, format, key, change}] headline outputs under the table (e.g. PV of terminal value, enterprise value); changes = {field: 'rel' | 'pp' | 'pts' | 'bps' | 'none'} overrides the automatic choice ('pts' = values already in percent units)

interactions: Drag or arrow keys (native range input, aria-valuetext formatted)
Click the value to type an exact number (9.25%, 9.25 or 0.0925)
Reset to base per slider
Store writes throttled while dragging; every computed field using the parameter recalculates
Preview cells flash and show the change vs. base (% for amounts, pp / bps for rates)

components.name: Query Console
components.summary: Client self-service analysis console: a pivot-style Builder and a validated query editor over the report's datasets, with a formatted results table, an automatic chart, CSV export, history and 'Add as metric'.
components.summary_zh: 客户自助分析控制台：透视表式“构建器”与带实时校验的查询编辑器，结果以格式化表格 + 自动图表呈现，支持 CSV 导出、查询历史和“保存为指标”。
components.description_zh: 让客户在报告内自己做分析：选择数据集，在 Builder 中按“值（聚合 × 字段）/ 分组 / 筛选 / 排序 / 前 N”拼出查询，或在 Query 中直接写 RK.query 语句（如 median(ev_ebitda_25e) by sector where region != "Latin America" sort 2 desc），编辑器带语法高亮、自动补全、防抖实时校验（错误信息 + 行列位置 + 波浪下划线）和 Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 运行。右侧参考面板列出字段（标题、名称、格式）、@参数与函数，点击即插入光标处。结果以按字段格式显示的可排序表格 + 自动图表（一个类别列用柱状图，年份 / 日期用折线图，单位不同则双轴，单行汇总显示为大数字）分屏呈现；结果遵循全局筛选并在筛选变化时自动重跑。行级公式可“Add as metric”写回数据集（Dataset.addComputed），其他图表随即可用；这些客户自定义指标按报告保存在本浏览器中，下次打开自动恢复，并列在参考面板的“My metrics”中（点击插入，× 删除）。界面文字随报告语言（RK.i18n，en / zh-CN）切换。
best_for: Letting clients answer their own follow-up questions on the comps / precedents / financials
Ad-hoc medians, averages and rankings by sector or region
Defining a new metric (e.g. EV / EBITDA 2026E) that other charts then use
Appendix 'data room' page of an interactive report
avoid_when: The page must tell one fixed story (use a purpose-built chart)
Printed deliverables (only the results table and chart print)
Very large datasets (> ~50k rows, the engine runs in the browser)

datasets.desc: Dataset ids offered in the picker (null = every loaded dataset)

dataset.desc: Initial dataset (default: the block's dataset, else the first available)

query.desc: Initial query text — opens the Query tab and runs on mount

builder.desc: Initial builder state {values:[{agg, field}], rows:[fields], where, sort:{col:'v0'|'r:field', dir}, top}; null = sensible default (median of a multiple by a low-cardinality text field)

examples.desc: [{label, query}] or query strings shown as clickable chips in the Query tab

tab.desc: Initial tab: builder | query (a 'query' option without 'builder' opens the Query tab)

chart.desc: auto | bar | line | none — auto = bar for one category column, line when it looks like a year / date

reference.desc: Side reference panel (fields, parameters, functions, syntax); collapses to a toggle in narrow blocks

history.desc: Remember recent queries in localStorage (silently disabled where storage is unavailable)

addMetric.desc: Offer 'Add as metric' for row-level formula columns (Dataset.addComputed with user: true — RK.data keeps the client's metrics in this browser, per report, and restores them on the next visit) and a 'My metrics' list in the reference panel (click to insert, × to delete)

highlight.desc: Value(s) whose result rows / bars are highlighted with accent-2 (e.g. the target company)

maxRows.desc: Rows rendered in the table (CSV exports all rows)

wheelZoom.desc: Long line charts (> 40 periods) get a zoom slider; null = Ctrl/Cmd + wheel or pinch zooms so the plain wheel scrolls the report, true = plain wheel zooms

tools.desc: Block toolbar (off: the console has its own CSV export)

interactions: Builder: pick aggregation / field / group-by / filter / sort / top N — runs as you edit
Query editor: syntax highlighting, autocomplete (Tab / Enter), live validation with line / column and wavy underline, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter
Reference panel: click a field, @parameter or function to insert at the caret
Sortable result columns; chart follows the table order
Results respect global filters and re-run when filters or @parameters change
Add as metric (Dataset.addComputed, user: true) — the new field appears in every field list and is saved in this browser for this report
Reference panel 'My metrics': the client's saved formulas, click to insert (or switch to their dataset), × to delete
CSV export, query history, example chips, dataset picker

components.description_zh: 用于管理层计划、DCF、LBO 等多情景页面：点击或用方向键切换情景，所有绑定了含情景字段数据集的图表会同步刷新。filter 模式在 RK.store 中设置 {field, op:'in', values:[情景]} 筛选；state 模式只写入一个状态键（RK.store.set），供声明了 listens 的组件自行读取。挂载时若尚未设置则自动应用默认情景，被外部清除时会恢复默认值，保证页面始终只展示一个情景。可在每个选项下显示该情景的关键数字（如 2028E EBITDA），并用说明文字解释情景假设。

components.name: Analysis at Various Prices
components.name_zh: 不同报价下的估值分析表（AVP）
components.summary: The M&A pitchbook AVP table: offer price levels as columns; premiums to reference prices, implied equity value, EV and implied multiples as rows — all computed live, offer column highlighted.
components.summary_zh: 并购项目书的核心表格：列为不同报价，行为相对参考价的溢价、隐含股权价值、企业价值与隐含估值倍数，全部实时计算，突出当前股价列与建议报价列。
components.description_zh: “不同报价下的估值分析”（Analysis at Various Prices）是并购建议书、董事会材料与公平意见书的标准表格。每一列是一个报价（options.prices 列表、{from, to, step} 区间，或绑定数据集的价格字段，可带“初始报价 / 修订报价”等列标签）；行依次为相对当前股价、30 日成交量加权均价（VWAP）、52 周最高价、未受影响股价的溢价 /（折价），隐含股权价值（报价 × 稀释股数）、净负债与隐含企业价值，以及由 metrics 定义的 EV / EBITDA、P/E 等隐含倍数——所有数字由组件根据 shares、netDebt、metrics 实时计算。当前股价列与建议报价列（accent2）高亮；报价可绑定 @参数（如 offer: "@offer"），通过表头上方的步进器、点击价格表头或页面上的参数滑块调整，整张表平滑重算。悬停单元格显示计算过程（如 EV ÷ EBITDA = 倍数）。
best_for: M&A offer price discussions (board / special committee materials)
Fairness opinion and proposal-history comparisons
Showing premiums and implied multiples at a proposed offer price
avoid_when: More than ~10 price columns
Trading valuation without an offer context (use comps-table / football-field)

components.summary_zh: 按估值方法展示估值区间的横向浮动条形图，叠加当前股价 / 报价参考线。
components.description_zh: 投行估值页的标志性图表。每一行是一种估值方法（DCF、可比公司、先例交易、52 周股价区间、分析师目标价等），横条两端为估值区间下限/上限，竖虚线（主题参考线颜色）标出当前股价或报价，阴影带可标出建议报价区间。可按 group 着色区分内在价值 / 市场法 / 交易法，并在左上角给出图例；52 周股价区间、分析师目标价等仅作参考的行（referenceGroups）按投行惯例以灰色显示。

More than ~10 methodologies

components.summary: Sum-of-the-parts build-up: each segment's metric × multiple range stacked into an EV range, then net debt and other deductions down to the implied equity value and value per share.
components.summary_zh: 分部加总估值累加图：各业务板块“指标 × 倍数区间”逐段累加成企业价值区间，再扣除净负债等调整项得到隐含股权价值与每股价值区间。
components.description_zh: 投行分部估值（SOTP）页的核心图表。数据每行一个业务板块（segment、metric_name、metric_value、multiple_low、multiple_high、method），每段横条在低倍数累计值上浮动：实色 = 按低倍数计算的价值贡献，浅色延伸 = 按高倍数多出的价值；公司总部费用等负值行与净负债、养老金、少数股东权益等扣减项依次向左回走，最后得到股权价值区间。左侧第二行文字给出“指标 × 倍数”的计算依据，右侧一列为每股价值，虚线参考线标出当前股价（股价 × 稀释股数，与图表同一 USD m 刻度）。适用于多元化集团、分拆 / 剥离分析与“集团折价”论证；净负债、股数等数值选项可绑定 @参数，随假设滑块实时重算。

Showing which segment drives value and the metric × multiple behind it

More than ~8 segments (aggregate the tail)
Segments valued on incompatible bases that cannot sum to one EV

components.summary: Values on a calendar: one cell per day (trading activity, volumes) with a sequential scale, or a year × month grid of monthly returns with diverging colours and a compounded full-year column.

Only two metrics (use a scatter)

components.name: Radar (Spider) Chart
components.summary: Benchmark the target against peers across 4–8 metrics at once: target as a filled accent polygon, peers as thin outlines, optional peer-median polygon.

components.name: Waterfall / Bridge
components.summary: Bridge from an opening to a closing total through signed steps — EBITDA bridge, EV-to-equity bridge, budget variance walk.
components.summary_zh: 从期初总额经过各项正负变动走到期末总额的桥接图：EBITDA 桥、企业价值到股权价值桥、预算差异分析。
components.description_zh: 每一行是一步：kind 为 total / subtotal 的柱子从 0 起画，delta 柱子从累计值处浮动，正向变动用 pos 色、负向用 neg 色、合计用主色，柱间以细连接线衔接，标签带 +/− 号。适用于解释两个数之间的差异由哪些驱动因素构成（如 FY25A→FY26E EBITDA 的量、价、成本、并购、汇率贡献，或 EV 扣减净债务、少数股东权益得到股权价值）。没有 kind 字段时自动把首尾两行当作合计；合计值缺失时按累计值计算；变动相对合计很小时可开启 axisBreak 断轴放大变动。

Enterprise value to equity value bridge
Budget vs. actual variance walk
Sources of value creation (LBO returns attribution)
avoid_when: More than ~15 steps (aggregate small drivers into 'Other')
Steps that are not additive (use a bar chart)
Time series of levels (use line / bar)

A single number per group is all that matters (use a bar)
Groups have only one or two observations each

components.summary_zh: 按数值比例绘制各阶段之间的流量宽度：从分部收入到净利润的损益流向、分部→地区收入、资金来源与用途。

components.name: China Tile Map
components.summary: Compliance-safe China cartogram: the 34 provincial-level divisions as equal-size squares or hexagons on a geography-like grid, shaded by a metric — no boundaries, so no map-review (审图号) issue in client decks.
components.summary_zh: 合规友好的中国省级方块地图：34 个省级行政区各占一个等大的方块（或六边形），按近似地理位置排布并按指标着色；不绘制任何边界线，客户材料中无需审图号。
components.description_zh: 用于在客户材料中展示按省汇总的指标（收入、增速、门店数、市场份额）。每个省级行政区（含台湾、香港、澳门，共 34 个）是一个同样大小的方块（或六边形），按地理相对位置排成 7 × 8 网格：黑龙江在右上，新疆、西藏在左侧，长江沿线（西藏—四川—重庆—湖北—安徽—江苏—上海）占一整行，海南在底部，港澳在广东下方，台湾在福建东侧；70 条省际陆地边界中有 63 条保留为相邻方块。因为不画边界、不涉及比例尺和领土轮廓，图表是示意图而非需要送审的“地图”，不会因边界画法引发合规问题（可选在空白角落标注“示意图，不代表实际边界”）；同时每个省面积相等，避免新疆、西藏、内蒙古等大省在视觉上压倒东部经济大省。数据可按 6 位行政区划代码（adcode，市/县级代码自动汇总到省）、中文或英文省名（带不带“省/市/自治区”均可，含 Inner Mongolia / Xizang / Macau 等常见写法）或 ISO 3166-2:CN 字母代码连接。方块颜色表示数值：顺序色阶或以中点为中心的发散色阶（如增速相对集团平均），默认按自然断点（Jenks）分 5 档，分界值取两档之间最整的数（取整不会把省份移到别的档），头部省份自成一档，图例显示每档省份数；也可用分位数、等距分档、自定义分界或连续色阶；无数据省份用斜线填充，与最浅一档区分。方块上显示中文简称（空间不足时用一字简称）或英文名（空间不足时用 ISO 代码，长名自动换行），空间足够时第二行显示格式化数值；重点省份在方块外侧加 2px 强调色描边（中间留纸色间隔，强调色与填充色过近时改用墨色）并加粗标签。图例默认放在网格左上角的空白处（放不下时自动换行，或移到网格旁边/下方）。悬停显示全部字段、排名（多行汇总时注明合计/平均）；点击方块交叉筛选其他图表；悬停图例高亮该档省份，点击图例按档筛选；被其他图表筛掉的省份变为浅色“幽灵”方块，颜色变化平滑过渡，布局保持不变。
best_for: Revenue / stores / headcount by province for China-client decks (no 审图号 needed)
Growth vs. a group average by province (diverging around the average)
Provincial footprint where area-based maps would over-weight Xinjiang / Tibet / Inner Mongolia
Small, print-safe national overview next to a table or commentary
avoid_when: Exact geography matters (distances, routes, city locations) — use bubble-map with an approved basemap
City- or county-level detail (tiles are provincial; city adcodes roll up to their province)
Precise comparison of close values — pair with a bar chart or table

id.desc: Province key: 6-digit adcode ("440000"; city / county codes roll up), Chinese or English name ("广东省", "广东", "Guangdong") or ISO 3166-2:CN letters ("GD", "CN-GD")

value.desc: Metric that drives the tile colour (several rows per province are combined with options.agg)

join.desc: auto | adcode | name — how encode.id values are matched (name also accepts ISO letters); unmatched keys are reported once in the console

lang.desc: Tile labels: 'zh' (北京, or 简称 京 on small tiles) | 'en' (Beijing, or ISO letters BJ on small tiles)

labels.desc: auto (short name when it fits every tile — multi-word English names wrap onto two lines — else 简称 / ISO code) | name | abbr | false

values.desc: Second line with the formatted value: auto (when every tile has room) | true | false. Without a value line the names grow into the free space

shape.desc: square | hex (pointy-top hexagons, odd rows offset half a tile)

scale.desc: auto (diverging when values straddle mid) | sequential | diverging

mid.desc: Diverging midpoint (0 for growth, or e.g. the group average)

bins.desc: Number of colour classes; 0 = continuous ramp. Diverging uses symmetric nice steps around mid (classes per side = bins / 2)

classify.desc: jenks (natural breaks: headline outliers get a class of their own) | quantile | equal — how sequential class breaks are found. Jenks breaks are the roundest number between the two classes they separate (rounding never moves a province across classes); quantile / equal breaks are rounded to nice numbers

breaks.desc: Explicit class breaks, e.g. [5, 10, 20, 40] (overrides bins / classify)

format.desc: Value format for tiles, legend and tooltip; defaults to the value field format

agg.desc: Combine several rows per province: sum | avg | max | min | median | first

highlight.desc: Province key(s) (adcode, name or ISO letters) marked with a 2px ring outside the tile on a paper halo plus a bold label, e.g. the target's home province. The ring is the accent colour, or the ink colour when the accent sits too close to a highlighted fill

highlightLabel.desc: Legend entry explaining the highlight outline (e.g. "Headquarters")

tooltip.desc: 'all' lists every field of the row (province name / code columns go to the title; with several rows per province numbers are summed, ratios averaged), an array of fields, or false (no tooltip)

legend.desc: Colour legend with province counts per class (rows depend only on the unfiltered data, so the layout never jumps when filters change); hover a class to focus its tiles, click it to cross-filter them

legendTitle.desc: Legend title; defaults to the value field title and unit

legendPosition.desc: auto (the empty top-left corner of the grid — wrapped onto several lines if needed — else beside or below the grid) | corner | left | right | bottom

filterField.desc: Field used for click-to-filter; defaults to encode.id. 'province' (a shared dimension) filters the whole report; other fields such as adcode only this block's dataset — set crossFilterScope to override

gap.desc: Gap between tiles in px (default about 6% of the cell, 2–5 px)

layout.desc: Position overrides {key: [row, col]}, keys as for encode.id (e.g. {"TW": [5, 6]})

note.desc: Small schematic disclaimer drawn in the free bottom-right corner (true: 'Schematic; no boundaries implied' / '示意图，不代表实际边界'), or your own text

components.summary: Countries shaded by a metric on an offline world basemap — sequential or diverging, continuous or classed with nice-rounded breaks.
components.summary_zh: 在离线世界底图上按指标给国家着色：顺序/发散色阶，连续或分级（自动取整的分档）。
components.description_zh: 展示按国家汇总的指标（收入、增速、员工数、市场份额）的地理分布。每行数据一个国家，通过 ISO 3166-1 数字代码（如 "840"）、三字母代码（如 "USA"）或国家英文名与 Natural Earth 底图连接；无数据的国家保持浅色陆地底色。默认按分位数分 5 档并取整为好看的分界值（如 <$20 / $20–50 / …），图例显示每档国家数；增速、相对均值偏离等有正负含义的指标用 diverging 色阶并设置中点。前 N 个国家直接标注数值，悬停显示数值、排名和附加字段，点击国家可交叉筛选其他图表。底图默认 world-110m；需要放大到区域（如欧洲）或包含新加坡、香港、摩纳哥、巴林等微型国家 / 地区时设 basemap 为 world-50m（1:50m 精度，构建器仅在用到时打包）。底图中没有多边形但带经纬度（lat / lon）的行会以同色阶的小圆点绘制，图例注明“• shown as points”。同一国家有多行时可用 aggregate（sum / avg / max …）汇总。

Growth vs. a benchmark (diverging around 0 or the group average)
Regional footprint at a glance
avoid_when: Precise comparison of values (use a bar chart)
Sub-national geography (needs another basemap)
Totals dominated by large countries' area — consider bubble-map for absolute values

components.summary: Dense point locations grouped into themed cluster bubbles (count or summed value, ring split by category) that break apart as you zoom; spiderfy at max zoom.
components.summary_zh: 密集点位自动聚合为主题化的聚合气泡（显示数量或数值合计，外环按类别占比分段），缩放时逐级展开，最大缩放时蛛网展开重叠点。

Print-only output (clusters depend on zoom)

components.name: Flow Map
components.summary: Origin -> destination flows as solid curved arcs: width by value, colour by category, arrowheads, nodes sized by total flow, travelling dots on hover.
components.summary_zh: 以弧线展示起点到终点的流向：线宽表示金额，颜色区分类别，箭头指向目的地，节点大小表示总流量，悬停时显示流动光点。
components.description_zh: 适合展示跨境并购、资本流动、贸易或客户迁移等“从哪里到哪里”的关系。每行一条流（起点/终点名称和经纬度、数值、可选笔数和类别）；相同起终点+类别的行自动合并。弧线宽度与数值成正比、箭头指向目标国，节点圆按流入+流出总额缩放；标注前 N 个国家及总额超过阈值的国家，其余国家在空间允许时就近标注，必要时用引线。弧线为实线（带纸色衬边，交叉处清晰），流动光点只在悬停时出现，静态截图与打印不会出现虚线效果。悬停某条弧线会突出该流并显示金额、笔数和占比；悬停国家节点会突出它的全部进出流量并显示净流出。点击弧线或图例按类别（如行业）交叉筛选其他图表。

Capital / trade / supply flows between regions
Client or revenue migration between markets

Flows without a meaningful geography (use sankey or chord)

components.name: Geo Heatmap
components.summary: Kernel density surface of point locations, optionally weighted by a value, in the theme's sequential colours with a numeric legend (total within a stated radius); toggle to reveal the underlying points.
components.summary_zh: 点位的核密度热力面（可按数值加权），使用主题顺序色阶；可一键叠加显示原始点位。
components.description_zh: 用连续的热力面展示点位在空间上的集中程度，适合看“哪里最密集 / 规模最集中”，例如产能、门店、客户或交易的地理集中度。每行一个点（lat / lon），可指定 weight 字段（如产能、收入）加权，邻近点按距离加权叠加。颜色来自主题顺序色阶，核半径为固定的地理距离（radius 按初始视图、1000px 宽地图的像素设定，随地图宽度缩放），因此图例给出具体数值：半径范围内按距离加权的合计（如“约 400 km 内的建筑面积”），并注明点数与合计。暗色主题下色阶止于次浅色，不出现发光效果。右上角按钮可叠加原始点位并标注最大的 N 个点位，悬停查看详情、点击交叉筛选。
best_for: Concentration of capacity / revenue / customers
Hundreds+ of points where individual markers are noise
Quick 'where is the weight' overview next to a table
avoid_when: Few points (use bubble-map — a heat surface over 10 points misleads)
Exact values must be read (density is relative)
Values attached to countries rather than points (use choropleth)

weight.desc: Optional weight per point (e.g. floor area); the surface and legend show the distance-weighted total within the kernel radius

label.desc: Point name for the points overlay tooltip / click-to-filter

radius.desc: Kernel radius in px on a 1000px-wide map at the initial view; scaled with the map width (a 760px page gets a smaller kernel, so nearby clusters stay apart). The kernel is geographic: it zooms with the map, and the legend states it in km

intensity.desc: Colour domain = the densest spot of the unfiltered data / intensity, rounded up to a nice number (> 1 saturates the peaks sooner)

minOpacity.desc: Opacity of the faintest visible density (the surface fades in from the kernel edge)

gradient.desc: Custom {stop: colour} map (stops 0-1); defaults to the theme sequential ramp

pointsToggle.desc: On-map button to show / hide the points (hidden in print)

labels.desc: Callouts (name and weight) on the N largest points while the points overlay is shown, with leader lines where they sit off the point (0 = none)

fit.desc: Initial view: 'data' | 'world' | [[south, west], [north, east]] | {center: [lat, lon], zoom}

legend.desc: Density legend with numeric ticks (0 / half / top of the colour domain, in the weight's units within ~N km), point count and total

Zoom / pan (density re-computed per zoom)
Updates with filters

components.summary: LBO / acquisition-financing Sources & Uses: two balancing pitchbook tables with % of total, x EBITDA, mix bars and footnotes; capitalization mode for a pro forma capital structure with cumulative leverage.
components.summary_zh: 杠杆收购 / 收购融资的资金来源与运用表：左右两张必须平衡的投行表格，含占比、EBITDA 倍数、构成条和脚注；capitalization 模式展示交割后资本结构与累计杠杆倍数。
components.description_zh: 交易融资页的标准表格：每行数据是一项资金来源（定期贷款、债券、现有现金、展期股权、发起人股权）或资金运用（收购股权、再融资、交易费用、融资费用、留存现金），side 字段区分左右两栏。每栏显示金额（货币符号只出现在首行和合计行，符合投行排版）、占本栏合计的百分比和 EBITDA 倍数（取自字段，或由 options.ebitda 计算），表头下方的迷你堆积条用序数色阶展示构成，行前色块即为图例；两栏合计行对齐在同一水平线上，若来源与运用不相等会显示红色“Out of balance”提示。notes 字段自动编号为脚注列在表格下方。mode: 'capitalization' 时读取 capital_structure（instrument / amount / rate / maturity / multiple_cum），显示利率、到期日、累计杠杆倍数与小计行，并以“杠杆阶梯”条标出各档债务的累计倍数。适合 LBO、收购融资和再融资方案页。

components.summary_zh: 交易流程时间表：按工作流分组的任务条（按阶段着色）、里程碑菱形、双层日历表头、“今天”线与时间缩放。
components.description_zh: 投行交易流程页（出售流程、IPO、再融资）的标准时间表。每行一个任务，按工作流（encode.group）分组并带粗体分组标题行与汇总括线；任务条按阶段（encode.phase）着色并在左上角给出图例；milestone 为 true 或开始=结束日期的任务画成菱形并标注日期。顶部为双层日历表头（月/周起始日，随缩放自动切换为年/月或年/季度），可用 today 画出“今天”竖线并淡化已过去的时间段。鼠标悬停显示起止日期、工期（天/周）和负责人；点击任务或分组标题可按工作流交叉筛选其他组件；Ctrl + 滚轮、双指捏合或底部滑块缩放时间轴（普通滚轮照常滚动页面）。

components.summary_zh: 按时间轴排列的事件里程碑：标签上下交替并自动分层避免重叠，引线不交叉，按事件类型区分形状与颜色；窄版块自动切换为纵向布局。
components.description_zh: 展示公司重大事件（业绩发布、指引调整、并购、评级变化）或交易流程关键节点。数据为每行一个事件：日期（encode.date）、标题（encode.label）、类型（encode.kind，决定标记形状/颜色与图例）、说明（encode.detail，显示在提示框或纵向布局的正文中）。横向布局按真实时间比例定位，标签在轴上下交替，拥挤时自动分层且保证引线不穿过其他标签，底部为季度/年份刻度，可加“今天”虚线；版块较窄（< 560px）或 orientation 为 vertical 时改为“日期列 | 轴 | 标题+说明”的纵向列表，并以年份胶囊分隔。点击事件或图例按类型交叉筛选（例如让股价图只显示业绩类事件），筛选变化时标签平滑移动到新位置。也可配合 where 只显示交易时间表中的里程碑。

Regulatory or financing calendar
